description: A tie ends the stage at ranking before emission. Both candidate emissions would have legal empty tag sets, but the tied stage emits nothing (engine §6, §11.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text p | q
%rule p $a:A %emits $a :: ($a.tags ∖ A)

%rule q $a:A %emits $a :: ($a.tags ∖ A)
